title: Canceled my subscription
text:
Allure misleads. They advertise that the products are previous allure award winners but what they don’t tell you is the only allure award winners are in sample sizes and the rest of the box is the same OLD items nobody wants from all the other beauty boxes.
Plus if you subscribe by Amazon Allure no longer let you shop exclusive sales from their store. And you don’t get your box any faster.
label: negative
